reviews.author: Josh Sirbaugh
reviews.text: Took my 2019 Chevy equinox here last week due to me towing the car down on a front wheel trailer which a killed my battery so I took it to Gary’s auto and they had it for about half a week and at first, they couldn’t get the car to start and thensaid the brake switch needed to be replaced to get the car started I told them to test the battery or swap the battery out with a new one to see if it was just the battery $246 later they replaced my brake switch for no reason he said his mechanic said it was throwing up a code saying the brake switch needed to be replaced, and I took it to the Chevy dealership and it was the battery. Simple fix and I got scammed out of 246!!!! This place must be under new ownership, but I would never recommend using this place

reviews.author: Dylan Adams
reviews.text: Terrible business ethics and quality of work! Performed exhaust work on my Tacoma and got it back extremely loud afterward . Charged me for a new muffler and installed a used one off a Silverado 1500. Refused to fix their mistake or refund me my money. Now i have a tacoma thats sounds like a straight piped honda civic.

reviews.author: Chris Clark
reviews.text: The engine had to be replaced on my jeep. They told me it would be $5000 to replace the engine or $6000 to rebuild it. with the replaced engine, I would get a four year warranty. So I agreed to pay $5000. After a week and a half went by, they told me that the company tried to charge them an extra thousand dollars for the engine, but they found another one for only $375 more., So I told him to go ahead. After another two weeks went by they said the engine they bought had broken parts on it and they had to send it back and get another one. then they told me that I had to get new motor mounts and they would not charge me labor only parks and it would be almost $500. But then I sent them screenshots of how much actual motor mounts cost which was less than $150. So they agreed to only charge me $299 for motor mounts. The final amount came to $6000 and the warranty went from four years to only six months.

reviews.author: Jayne gourdeau
reviews.text: I took my vehicle in for an exhaust leak. The mechanic replaced the flex pipes. the cost was very reasonable, and the staff was very friendly. I had to take it back because I could still smell fumes, and they fixed a gasket at no charge. I would take my vehicle back here again.

reviews.author: amber thomas
reviews.text: I moved to Myrtle Beach a year ago and had not found a reliable mechanic until now. My car broke down and I had to find a repair shop. I have had bad experiences since I moved here with other mechanics including the dealership. I knew what needed to be fixed was super expensive and of course when something like that breaks down it is always the worst time financially. I prayed about it and looked at reviews and decided to call Garys Auto. From the very start I had excellent customer service! They made me feel like they knew me personally. Not only did they do an excellent job fixing my car, they did it very fast and for not even a fraction of what the price could have been. They are definitely my new mechanic!! Thank you for your excellent service!

reviews.author: Michael Vasilev
reviews.text: Last week while traveling to Myrtle Beach from Cleveland, we experienced some car problems with my daughters Dodge Caravan. Nothing too serious, I was able to drive to a Walmart close by and tie it up temporarily until we arrived and were able to have it repaired while we vacationed. I looked around Google and found Gary’s and read some of their reviews and decided to go with them because not only did they have great reviews, the price they quoted over the phone was the most reasonable I had received. Honestly I can say the work they did was fantastic. I usually handle all my car repairs so I tend to be a little more of a pain in the butt customer when I must let someone else do the repairs. They did everything I would’ve done and better. Gary was a very personable man and I enjoyed talking to him about politics and fishing. His tips helped me land my first shark ever which I’ll never forget and my son in law also caught one too!! We plan on traveling back every year from now on and in the event we ever have any car issues I will definitely 100% take my car there from now on. Their price was beyond fair and the quality of work was above par by far. Thank you Gary and Casey for helping us have a fantastic time and all your hard work as well.

reviews.author: Mark Allen
reviews.text: We took our beloved ‘65 Mustang to the shop for an upgraded exhaust system. Before the work began, Rock discussed all our options and cost. Made an appointment and the work started only a few days after our initial discussion. We could not be more pleased with the quality of work done by Rock; meticulous with attention to detail. He treated our car as if it was his own. Can’t say enough about the exemplary service we received. Thanks Rock. Blaine, you have a terrific team at the shop. We appreciate the service and it was pleasure doing business with you. Best Regards.

reviews.author: Devin Lewis
reviews.text: Great people. Very knowledgeable and good at what they do. Rock did an amazing job on my exhaust! Best in the business!

reviews.author: Mothman Overland
reviews.text: Came in for partial exhaust. Quote was quick and easy. Everyone up front and in the back were great people through and through. Didn't charge an arm and a leg for the work and I would 100% trust them to do any repair to my vehicle 100% of the time. Probably one of the best shops I've ever been to between the east coast and Midwest. Pic below is what they had to deal with replacing, I will be back to get it finished out.

reviews.author: Tim Miller
reviews.text: I bought a 2003 short bus and took it to Gary’s . They did a thorough inspection Made the necessary repairs timely and under estimate Thanks Tim

reviews.author: Gerard Devito
reviews.text: Maybe when Gary owned it it was a good shop, but run from the new owners. Back in May I had header gaskets installed on my 2016 Ram. Brought it back yesterday for an exhaust noise it has a broken stud in the flange, and one of the header exhaust bolts fell out. The new owner said they won't warrantee it. Mechanic told me all they've been doing is warranty work from when Gary owned it. And they won't help me. Run from this place stay away

reviews.author: Judy Plummer
reviews.text: These guys work on all my cars. They are honest, do great work, and prices are reasonable. And they are just nice guys. The tire came off my brother's wheelchair ine day and I took it up to them to see if they could fix it. Let me tell you it was no easy task. It took three guys, a couple of tire irons and at least 20 mins. They would not take payment or even a tip. Love this place and the people who work there. I highly recommend.

reviews.author: LaVerne Melton
reviews.text: I had gotten a muffler job done. The service was great and the people that worked there was excellent, polite and friendly. The prices are reasonable and fare. I would recommend them to everyone who need car service.

reviews.author: Danny Hall
reviews.text: Beyond amazing folks. Called up for an emergency exhaust issue. Young lady told me to bring it in. Showed up mechanic came and got the truck let it cool down for a few put the repair on it and me and the family were on the way. Maybe 20 minutes total. 10/10 recommend and will be back if i ever. Need anything

reviews.author: Greg Morgan
reviews.text: My son and I brought in his 2013 RS Camaro to get an exhaust quote. We were going to buy an after market system and have Rock install it. He instructed us just to buy the axle back kit instead of the whole cat back kit because he could save us some cash and make the cat back pipes with the H section himself. We agreed to the quote and ordered the parts. Fast forward a week later and we dropped the car of with the axle back kit and waited for the call to come and get it. My phone rang about an hour later and it was Rock.He told me that the car already had a dual exhaust system installed with the H pipe and all he had to do was install the axle back kit. I never would have known this and with Rock and Gary's Auto & Exhaust being 100% HONEST and upfront with me, saved me a few hundred dollars. As long as we live in Myrtle Beach, they will have my business. Go there with 100% confidence, you will not regret it.

reviews.author: Gator Bait Adventure Tours
reviews.text: Great customer service and professional attitude! They work fast and make sure it's done right the first time. Our go to mechanic for years, honest, fair prices and locally owned, they care about their customers and keep us on the road!

reviews.author: Ricki Mansfield
reviews.text: They assured me that the mechanic could fix my Jeep. After all the trouble I had getting it to them I was told they couldn't work on that model. We discussed that on the phone before I took it there. The people charged me 120.00 for looking at it? Rip off place. Stay Away !!!!!

reviews.author: Darin Wand
reviews.text: Our first trip to Myrtle Beach(from Atlanta area) started off with our car taking a dirt nap on us. Gary's Auto was literally right there when the car was acting up, only six miles from our destination, so we pulled in and asked for assistance. Long story short, our 2013 Hyundai Tuscon with only 70k miles had the engine croak. I can't speak to the actual repair as we are going to have to work with Hyundai dealership with that, but the care, consideration and overall friendliness of Blaine and his staff was beyond any expectations. Seriously, very genuine folks that I would recommend to anyone to care for their vehicle.

reviews.author: Kimberly Bork
reviews.text: I never write reviews, but I felt obligated to write this one about Gary’s auto. My Lexus had a lot of mechanical problems, and Gary’s auto took care of everything so quickly that I was truly amazed. Blaine offered to give me a ride when I was without my car and gave me a price beyond fair. If anyone needs a trustworthy mechanic and doesn’t want to get screwed over this is the spot.

reviews.author: Cayce Reisman
reviews.text: The staff at Gary’s auto are awesome! They are honest, fair and diligent. I can’t thank them enough for their hard work. It’s hard to trust car repair places but I never felt that way with them. Blaine answered all my questions and helped me so much! Thank you

reviews.author: Joseph Savitsky
reviews.text: Very expressive. I got a lower price from the dealership but decided to do the 15 min project myself I was quoted 1.5 hrs. for a simple door check and they said you can only get oem from Ford for almost $200 bucks when I found it online under $40. For some reason I can't reply so here is the reply: My response to the oil change for $50 was high since I usually get it done for about $30. The OEM part is $118. You priced it over $180. Dealer labor from software says about 50 minutes but that's for slow folks. You estimated an hour and a half to pop a door panel and three bolts.

reviews.author: Myke Johnson
reviews.text: He told me to bring my car in early as possible and even tho i didn't get there until 11:00 they didn't complain or utter one bad word only thing they ask me was can you leave the car? I left the car and no more than 2 hours later they told me i can pick it up and he even gave me a better price than originally that was set, i got in my car fired it up and woooooboooobooooo i was extremely satisfied and it sounded alot better than i expected excellent job guys! im bringing another one of my rides here as this will be the 3rd vehicle they worked on for me so if you looking for good quality craftsmanship at a great price and do come see these guys.

reviews.author: Oscar Aguinaga
reviews.text: I told Blaine that I had only a certain amount of money for job to be done and knowing that price they still only charged me a fraction of the cost...I am so happy I went here. I highly recommend! Thanks Blaine... there are still some honest people out there.

reviews.author: Bruce Paris
reviews.text: Amazing customer service. I've come two weeks 1 row to have a wheel bearing pressed and I've gotten immediate service. Today I came at 4:20 they close at 5. Once again they helped me out. Awesome mechanics that do an outstanding job. Thanks again I greatly appreciate your help!!

reviews.author: Wesley Martinez (Wes)
reviews.text: Was quoted a price over the phone for around $295 came to the shop the next day and the price doubled. Only wanted simple work done I would not recommend any company that does not provide a realistic quote or even honor a discounted price for a bad quote. Just bad business

reviews.author: Jaime Pando
reviews.text: Is so difficult to find a Auto Technician that is talented and more importantly honest. The old adagio "don't judge a book for its cover", applies here.Lee and his Team are good in both terms, they do a good job, and you do not have to worry about them selling you what you do not need. At least that has been my experience thus far. I will continue doing business with Gary's Auto. They have proven to me, that they are worth of it.

reviews.author: Kimberly Jones
reviews.text: The customer service here was just absolutely amazing! I found my new mechanic! Unbeatable prices and always there to help! Thank you so much. I am seriously grateful!

reviews.author: Johnny Shell
reviews.text: Had a muffler swap on my 05 tahoe. Took one I got from advance in. They squeezed me in on a busy rainy friday. Excellent service. Great people. Mr blain himself handled all my stupid questions. Thank you guys

reviews.author: Mary Cooney
reviews.text: Garys has always done a fantastic job on our cars. I have used them for years and have never been disappointed. I can't say that about anywhere else I have been. Thanks to Gary's and all the staff. ATW

reviews.author: Ken Pankowski
reviews.text: Just got back from Gary's Auto, and he did the brakes on my wife's G5 and for about half of what other local shops quoted for the same work. Car drives great, wife's happy and we saved some serious cash. Gary's the Go To Guy!

reviews.author: Kevin Johnson
reviews.text: I’ve been here a handful of times for different vehicles. They do quality work and They have always been quick and always show me exactly what’s going on, instead of making me take there word for it. Honest good labor. Hard to find

reviews.author: Frank W
reviews.text: The receptionist and technician are nice. They fixed my AC perfectly. They even fixed other problems without extra charge. They really make sure their work was good.

reviews.author: Bronna Miller
reviews.text: This company is hands-down one of the best automotive places to take your car. Very reasonably priced and they go above and beyond for their customers, would highly recommend to others.

reviews.author: Mal Angle
reviews.text: The only place in Myrtle Beach that won't skrew you over for a dollar, even for a woman that is alone. Never had an issue with this place. Gary and his men are awesome and have wonderful customer service

reviews.author: Jason Ford
reviews.text: ALL staff are professional and friendly. They know exactly what they're doing and for the right price. I've had multiple jobs done here and I will continue to come back. I highly recommend this shop to friends and family. SEMPER FIDELIS

reviews.author: Paul Graves
reviews.text: Been using Gay's Auto for about 10 yrs now. ALWAYS did me right ! They've even done well by people I've referred to them. Great place !

reviews.author: everette robbins
reviews.text: Not trustworthy. Will never use them again. Said charge would be $150 to $160 then gave me a bill for $350. No justification whatsoever for a bill of $350. Learned a lesson here.

reviews.author: Stay Humble
reviews.text: Nice guys. Paid less than I was quoted over the phone. Truck sounds great! I will be back if I need anything else fixed.

reviews.author: Jon Zeleny
reviews.text: Went for some custom exhaust work. Solid, clean work done in a timely manner. I will gladly return to Gary's.

reviews.author: Doug&Sandra Johnson
reviews.text: Finally found a great mechanic that is honest. I wished I had known about these guys years ago. Now all my family goes to Gary.

reviews.author: Allscape Patio & Landscape
reviews.text: Very good experience. I'm particular with my work and they did a fantastic job. Fast and very fair! Definitely recommend.

reviews.author: PIERRE LACROIX
reviews.text: Beyond my expectations! Thank you, Gary. After getting a flat tire, my exhaust system needed replacing before I could drive back to Canada. Even Ford couldn't take me for another week. Gary asked me to come in the morning, and by late afternoon everything was sorted! Thanks again for everything!
